She has a delicate oval-to-heart-shaped face, softly rounded cheeks, a gently tapered jawline, a small refined chin, a petite straight nose, and naturally full, softly parted rose-pink lips revealing a subtle glimpse of her upper teeth. Her complexion is fair and luminous with warm peach undertones, delicate rosy blush across her cheeks, realistic fine skin texture, and soft natural highlights across her forehead, nose, collarbones, shoulders, and upper chest.

She has a slender yet naturally curvaceous physique, graceful shoulders, a defined waist, and a full bust with realistic anatomical proportions. The soft, slightly stretchy fabric follows her natural silhouette with subtle folds and realistic textile texture.

The composition is an intimate, slightly elevated, high-angle selfie, tightly cropped from just above her forehead to her lower chest. Her face dominates the upper center of the frame, while her shoulders and upper torso fill the foreground. One arm is lifted overhead, extending diagonally across the upper-right corner, creating an effortless, casually posed silhouette. Her head is tilted slightly, and her torso angles subtly toward the camera.

The background features softly blurred pale gray walls and light neutral interior surfaces, creating a clean, understated domestic atmosphere. Gentle diffused daylight illuminates her face from the front-left, producing smooth tonal transitions, subtle shadows beneath her chin, natural skin luminosity, and delicate reflections on her glasses.
